name: The AI Scientist
what: Turns a scientific hypothesis into a structured, operationally grounded experiment plan. Took second place at the MIT Club of Northern California and MIT Club of Germany hackathon, Challenge 04.

name: AmplifyAI
what: An AI-powered social media content agent, entered in the same hackathon; it did not place.

name: AccountingV2
what: An offline-first Android budgeting app built around envelope budgeting and debt snowball methods, with cloud sync.

name: NASA Sky Hub
what: A Home Assistant integration combining NASA public APIs, satellite tracking and sky visibility calculations into a glanceable view of what is overhead.

name: Easy Equities for Home Assistant
what: A Home Assistant integration that surfaces an Easy Equities and Satrix portfolio on a personal dashboard.

name: AI-first engineering workspace
what: A Cursor ruleset and workspace scaffolding for spec-driven, AI-assisted development: one workflow from constitution and PRD through tasks to verification, with quality gates.

name: BibleStudy
what: A project with two goals held together: studying scripture systematically, and learning to build agentic AI systems through real work rather than tutorials.

name: AITrainingGuide
what: A hands-on AI training course for business professionals with no coding background, covering agents and retrieval-augmented generation. Built on TypeScript, React and Firebase.

name: OpenClaw
what: An open-source personal AI assistant. Not my project: I contributed 55 commits to it between March and April 2026.

name: Weight certificate converter
what: A Streamlit application that converts scanned weight certificate PDFs into structured JSON using OCR, with optional schema validation.

name: TruthAISwarm
what: An exploration of a decentralised, AI-assisted approach to identifying misinformation.
